_comment: What every prompt (review, issues, conflicts, audit) whose target repository is hosted on GitLab adds, as its own paragraph right after the opening task line. {host} is the GitLab host, {owner} the project's namespace (it may hold '/'), {repo} the project.
promptNote: This repository is hosted on GitLab at {host} (project {owner}/{repo}), not on GitHub. Wherever these instructions say GitHub, `gh`, pull request or PR, read GitLab, `glab`, merge request and MR: `glab` is installed and signed in to {host}; run it inside the checkout or pass `--repo https://{host}/{owner}/{repo}`. The equivalents: `glab mr view <n> --comments`, `glab mr diff <n>`, `glab mr create --draft`, `glab mr note <n>`, `glab mr update <n> --ready`, `glab issue view <n> --comments`, `glab issue note <n>`, `glab issue update <n> --assignee @me`, and `glab api` (REST `projects/:id/...` or `graphql`) for anything without a subcommand. PR #N here is merge request !N; an issue keeps #N. A formal review is a set of draft notes (`projects/:id/merge_requests/<n>/draft_notes`) published at once with `.../draft_notes/bulk_publish`, and resolving a thread is resolving its discussion. An MR closes an issue with `Closes #N` in its description.
